# Combination Padlock
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

![Combination Padlock](images/items/20261_combo_padlock.png)

*Use it to work the dials: push the shackle down to lock it and turn the dials to hide the code. On its code it springs open again. With a Chain it makes a Combination Lock and Chain.*
